data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic. The high volume of detailed, positive reviews mentioning specific staff and services is credible. The negative reviews are few but describe distinct, plausible failures (scheduling, a subpar cleaning job, reckless driving) rather than a pattern of the same core service issue. The business seems to excel at window/pressure washing but may have had a failed expansion into house cleaning.

Negative reviews contain specific, credible incidents (no-show, traffic incident, incomplete cleaning)
